purpose: This file gives the necessary behavior and bounded fault input for a temporary Nova lifecycle exercise. It records no execution result.

startingState.checkout: The checkout at the start must be clean and isolated. It must have no prepared implementation or test change.
startingState.baseline: Before you change the source, record the baseline lifecycle result, durable reason, and state counters. Record generated outputs and selected check results.
startingState.revisionPurpose: This immutable source revision identifies the unchanged product baseline for this scratch exercise. It records no execution result.

desiredBehavior.condition: An administrative attempt has a retry result that agrees with its contract. The attempt is running. Its normal reducer decision is for another nonterminal action and lets it retry in the configured budget.
desiredBehavior.result: The administrative attempt stops with stage status blocked. Its committed lifecycle event uses the new reason administrative_retry_suppressed. The original attempt result and its reason stay the same.
desiredBehavior.boundedScope: Add this diagnostic only for the administrative retry case. Preserve administrative_attempt_consumed for every other administrative nonterminal action. Preserve ordinary retry, wait, repair, success, failure, timeout, cancellation, and all attempt and repair budgets.
desiredBehavior.externalCompatibility: Do not change any schema version, event type, exported type, or package identity. Do not change any graph identity, digest encoding, CLI option, or generated contract output. Use the baseline lifecycle reason representation.

cases.expected: The engine consumes one attempt. The stage becomes blocked. The engine schedules no other attempt. The committed stage event reason is administrative_retry_suppressed. The original result reason stays exercise.transient_dependency.
The baseline bounded retry behavior stays the same. The new administrative diagnostic is absent.

input.wait: When you make the signal wait, obey the baseline contract. Give the authorized issuer and expiry values in its input.

cases.expected: The stage stays blocked for the administrative attempt with its baseline administrative_attempt_consumed reason.
Reject the result because the stage is not running. Preserve state, attempt counters, and journal bytes. Do not append a success or blocked transition.

cases.fault: After the engine durably commits the administrative blocked event, terminate the isolated process before local terminal projection or normal completion. Restart from the same retained records.
cases.expected: The journal retains administrative_retry_suppressed and the original attempt result reason. Recovery preserves blocked status and the consumed attempt count. It schedules no duplicate work. It leaves schema, graph, and digest identities unchanged. If a state projection has no reason field, the diagnostic is not necessary as a new field.

requiredProof: Before you change the source, find the canonical behavior owner and affected invariants. Also find the compatibility boundary, generated surfaces, and documentation owner.
From the published change guide, select the smallest chain with all necessary checks. Execute its unit, contract, replay, recovery, compatibility, and documentation checks.
Add direct assertions for the new condition and for all the other cases in this file. Do not infer coverage from a test name.

Keep the revision, environment, commands, exit codes, and journal identities without change outside the scratch checkout. Keep observations, failures, and skips without change there. A missing prerequisite or a read-only description is not execution evidence.

removal.action: Remove the temporary implementation and test changes in the isolated scratch checkout.
removal.expected: Restore the original lifecycle behavior and administrative_attempt_consumed reason. Tracked source, generated outputs, external contract, and identities must match the recorded baseline. All selected checks must exit with code zero again. No exercise process, temporary store, or generated test state can remain.
removal.retainedEvidence: Keep baseline, changed, interruption, and removal reports outside the temporary checkout. Do not remove deployed records or product state to complete this exercise.
